name: feeds-speeds-native
description: Feeds & Speeds — native iOS/Android app (Expo/React Native) + Next.js API, one codebase.

scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @feedspeed/core typecheck && npm run -w @feedspeed/mobile typecheck && npm run -w @feedspeed/api typecheck

//: expo-router is declared here so npm hoists it to the root node_modules; babel-preset-expo resolves it from there to enable the router transform. Keep the range in sync with apps/mobile.
//overrides: Pin react + react-dom to the exact Expo SDK 57 version everywhere so a hoisted newer react can't mismatch react-dom (which breaks the Next.js build).
